testcase.name: install callback alone is insufficient when the registry is absent or disabled
filtering readiness failure keeps navigation blocked after a successful install
retry after a failed wait adopts a later user disable without reinstalling
version comparison orders AMO releases and never ranks garbage as newer
user disabling uBO during the first-run wait continues without the failure dialog
existing extension updated during a later startup is awaited at its new version
restart recovers installation committed before completion marker without reinstalling
asset hash denial blocks installation and never grants trusted permissions
failed install remains failed until retry and never records completion
registry query failures before and after installation remain visible and block readiness
timeout cancels the active install and revokes permission trust
interrupted absent installation requires an explicit retry even after restart
existing updated extension waits for its installed version without replacing it
runtime asset verifier preserves bytes matching the pinned size and hash
permission trust requires a verified active transaction and exact ID version and file URI
absent disabled same or older copy after a failed wait keeps the failure
replacement registered shortly after the failed wait is still adopted
reload or a disable the user did not make during the wait keeps the failure
signed update replacing the awaited version during first run is awaited instead
completed removal survives restart and a different bundled version
runtime asset verifier rejects changed bytes with the same length
user disabling or removing a provisioned uBO during a later startup continues
existing disabled extension stays disabled without installation or a filtering wait
wrong verified asset ID cannot activate an installation transaction
runtime asset verifier rejects wrong length even with the correct hash
replacements during startup are bounded
first launch installs once and holds navigation until filtering is ready
